name: MoveEvent
description: informs the consumers that a positional update should be processed for a particular gameobject

contextPassed.gameobjectID: <id of the gameobject whose position is to be updated>
contextPassed.moveX: <distance by which the obejct should move in x-direction>
contextPassed.moveY: <distance by which the obejct should move in y-direction>

name: CollisionOccuredEvent
description: informs the game that a collision occured between 2 gameobjects

contextPassed.object1_ID: <id of the one object in the collision pair>
contextPassed.object2_ID: <id of other object in the collision pair>

consumerComponents: Transform  ->  for the resolution of the collision
